decisions.reason: The cobot loading system extends the firm's established machining offer, fits its announced push toward smarter automation, and needs little extra investment to keep, so management will stay with it.
The dual-table loading system is a low-risk automation accessory built on the core business, fits the stated automation strategy, and shows no sign of failure, so it remains on the market.

The firm has invested heavily in the dispensing machine, presents it publicly as a flagship with its own page and a Red Dot award, and can attribute any slow uptake in a new market to temporary ramp-up, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.
